about.heading: About
about.bio: Computer engineer pursuing a dual M.Sc. in Complex Systems Engineering and Computer Engineering (Erasmus Mundus EMSSE, Université de Technologie de Compiègne & University of Genova), after a B.Sc. in Computer Science from The American University in Cairo (Dean's List, 3.6/4.0). Engineering experience spans Ernst & Young's technology practice, Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank's AI and security team, and a production NLP chatbot still serving 1,000+ users today. I bring that same engineering rigor to every website and online store I build — Django, FastAPI, React, and Node.js are daily tools, not a sideline skill.
